summary: F19 header fidelity: the title and status line are separated by the reference's 16px slate-200 divider, and the status dot wears its 4px state ring with the measuring amber pulse and the rebinding indigo ping, driving its own frames only while it animates.

HEADER-TITLE-DIVIDER-AND-STATUS-RING.evidence: The header now paints the reference's `h-4 w-px bg-slate-200` divider between the title and the status line, pinned by the_title_and_status_are_separated_by_the_reference_divider (exactly one 1x16 theme::BORDER rect, right of the title label). The status dot paints the 8px circle inside its 4px ring in the reference's four state pairs, pinned by the_synced_dot_wears_the_emerald_ring and the_idle_dot_stays_slate_without_an_animation, and the two animations are pinned by the_measuring_dot_pulses_amber and the_rebinding_dot_pings_indigo (state inks plus a sub-50ms repaint request) and by the_pulse_and_ping_waves_match_the_reference_cycles (full-to-half opacity at the pulse midpoint; double radius and zero alpha at the ping's 75% keyframe). The dot state precedence is pinned by the_dot_state_follows_the_reference_precedence, and the unowned ui_semantic rebinding flow passes against the animated dot in the gate.

risks: The ring steps amber-100 (#fef3c6) and emerald-100 (#d0fae5) and the indigo-500 ink (#615fff) are derived from the reference's Tailwind v4 oklch declarations; the conversion reproduces five verified theme read-backs exactly, but theme.rs owns no such tokens and is outside this task's ownership (preview.rs carries the same indigo-500 for its dot highlight).

The dot requests its next frame at the backend's predicted frame time plus a millisecond rather than a fixed 60 Hz delay, because egui subtracts the predicted frame time from every request and a smaller delay collapses into an immediate repaint loop; the animation therefore follows the backend cadence.

The inactive state folds the disconnected runtime into the reference's engine-off slate pair, because the reference has no separate connection state and no engine status can be trusted without a connection; this replaces the previous connected-based emerald/slate pair.
Native visual confirmation is outside this execution; the divider, ring, and animations are pinned by egui_kittest widget and unit tests only.
